patch_description: This ansatz retains only one distinct circuit parameter, improving parameter efficiency over the current two-angle model and matching the strongest prior parameter economy. A collective RY layer is followed by the original Möbius ladder, then a noncommuting collective RX layer and a shifted chord matching. Because RX does not commute with the surrounding CZ networks, the tied three-block repetition generates alternating correlation transformations rather than merely adding redundant commuting gates. The fixed shifted links increase nonlocal correlation coverage without adding trainable degrees of freedom, aiming to improve worst-group separation while preserving strong few-shot regularization.
